Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent game sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, exactly THREE evenly separated full-body children in ONE ROW, each fully inside its own third. Input images 1/2/3 lock their respective identities: first boy black tousled hair orange T-shirt blue shorts blue backpack; second girl ponytail red bow yellow shirt red floral skirt red backpack; third curly boy blue-white-orange sailboat cap white sailboat shirt green shorts green backpack. Preserve exact face, clothing, colors, bags, shoes. Change pose ONLY: they are gently recovering balance at a train doorway, NOT falling. Both feet visibly planted but one knee bent, torso leaning LEFT by 15 degrees, left arm extended outward LEFT with open palm to brace a door frame, right arm spread sideways to balance. Clearly DIFFERENT silhouette from normal hands-on-backpack standing and from walking or sitting. Cheerful reassuring expressions. View from front, facing slightly LEFT toward cabin. No door frame or floor should be rendered; just the three separated cutout sprites. Same head height and foot baseline across three. Large clean silhouette readable at 64px. Transparent alpha background. No text, labels, panels, props, chairs or shadows. Return local generated file path.
